skill: When the onmyoji's HP drops below 70% of their max HP, summons Tomb Guard to permanently increase all allies' Crit DMG by 30%. The effect triggers up to once each battle

When the onmyoji uses a Skill, increases their Crit by 100% for 2 turns; if single-target damage is dealt with the Skill, increases the damage by 50%; if only one target is attacked, orders Snowball to launch a follow-up strike on the enemy, dealing damage equal to 150% of the onmyoji's ATK.

Increases the Coin yield in Exploration zone battles by 5%.
At the end of the onmyoji's turn, heals the HP of the ally with the lowest HP by 12% of their max HP and increases their DEF by 30% for 2 turns.
Grants 2 orbs at the start of battle and launches a 3-strike attack on all enemies at the end of the onmyoji's turn, dealing damage equal to 100% of the onmyoji's ATK.

For every 5 instances of CRIT DMG dealt by the ally with the highest ATK, the next attack deals an additional true damage equal to 50% of the onmyoji's ATK (not exceeding 100% of the initial ATK.) When the onmyoji deals damage, attacks all enemies 3 times, each dealing true damage equal to 200% of the Onmyoji's ATK.

When an allied shikigami takes lethal damage, restores HP to 20% and the onmyoji shares the excess damage (this effect can be trigged up to 3 times.) When the Onmyoji's HP is 50% or below, Soul Edge attacks all enemies, dealing 100% daamge and increasing all allies damage by 30% for 2 turns. Cooldown: 2 turns.
Upper Hand: Grants the Onmyoji Moon Blessing: Increases SPD by 30. At the end of the turn, raises the move bar of another ally at the top of the turn order by 20%.
Increases Effect HIT by 20%. After the Onmyoji acts for 2 turns, summons fox spirits to attack all enemies, dealing 100% damage twice and additionally increasing the Onmyoji's Effect HIT by 30%.
